english.title: Sell / transfer prohibited weapon / ammunition
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), without the written authority of the Secretary of State, sold or transferred

(A)_[a weapon]_
(B)_[ammunition]_

specified in **(..SPECIFY THE APPROPRIATE PARAGRAPH OF SUBSECTION 5(1) or 5(1A)..) of the Firearms Act 1968, namely **(..SPECIFY NATURE OF PROHIBITED WEAPON / AMMUNITION..)
english.legislation: Contrary to section 5(2A)(b) of, and Schedule 6 to, the Firearms Act 1968.

english.notes:
(i) This offence document and associated codes should only be used for offences committed on or after 14th July 2014.
(ii) See related offences regarding distribution of prohibited weapons - H11537 (manufacture), H11539 (possess for sale/transfer) and H11540 (purchase/acquire for sale/transfer).
(iii) On conviction for this offence, the court can order the forfeiture or disposal of any firearm or ammunition and cancellation of any firearm certificate or shot gun certificate, and any firearm or ammunition subject of such order may be seized or detained by a constable (section 52 of the Firearms Act 1968).

other.penalty:
Indictment: maximum life imprisonment and/or a fine.

A minimum sentence may apply to this offence, see section 311 of, and Schedule 20 to, the Sentencing Act 2020.

Time limit for prosecutions:
None
